kjv: indeed, no doubt, surely, (it is, of a) true(-ly, -th).

words.word: it is so of a truth

occurrences.text: And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.
Of a truth, Lord, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,
I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?

occurrences.text: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
